table.name: concert
table.purpose: One row per concert (episode of a singing-competition show, given names like 'Auditions', 'Super bootcamp', 'Home Visits'), held at a stadium in a given year with a musical theme.

Stadium_ID.name: Stadium_ID
Stadium_ID.description: Identifier of the stadium hosting the concert; references stadium.Stadium_ID (many concerts to one stadium).

Theme.name: Theme
Theme.description: Theme of the concert; values are song titles (e.g. 'Bleeding Love', 'Wide Awake') or free-choice themes.

Year.name: Year
Year.description: Year the concert took place (2014 or 2015).

concert_ID.name: concert_ID
concert_ID.description: Primary key identifying the concert; referenced by singer_in_concert.concert_ID to link singers to concerts.

concert_Name.name: concert_Name
concert_Name.description: Name of the concert/episode, e.g. 'Auditions', 'Super bootcamp', 'Home Visits', 'Week 1'.

table.name: singer
table.purpose: Directory of singers, each with one signature song, its release year, age, country of origin and gender. Referenced by singer_in_concert to link singers to concerts held in stadiums.

Age.name: age
Age.description: Age of the singer in years (25-52).

Country.name: country
Country.description: Country of origin of the singer (e.g. France, Netherlands, United States).

Is_male.name: is_male
Is_male.description: Gender flag stored as 'T'/'F' text: T = male, F = female.

Name.name: name
Name.description: Full name or stage name of the singer (e.g. 'Timbaland', 'Rose White').

Singer_ID.name: singer_id
Singer_ID.description: Primary key identifying the singer; referenced by singer_in_concert.Singer_ID.

Song_Name.name: song_name
Song_Name.description: Name of the singer's (signature) song, e.g. 'Hey Oh', 'Gentleman'.

Song_release_year.name: song_release_year
Song_release_year.description: Year the song was released (1992-2016), stored as text.

table.name: singer_in_concert
table.purpose: Junction/association table linking singers to the concerts they perform in (many-to-many between singer and concert).

Singer_ID.name: Singer_ID
Singer_ID.description: Identifier of the singer performing in the concert; references singer.Singer_ID (many-to-one).

concert_ID.name: concert_ID
concert_ID.description: Identifier of the concert; references concert.concert_ID (many-to-one).

table.name: stadium
table.purpose: Reference table of football stadiums (Scottish football clubs), one row per stadium, with capacity and attendance statistics. Referenced by concert.Stadium_ID for concerts held at each stadium.

Average.name: Average attendance
Average.description: Average attendance at the stadium (spectators per match); values 552-2106, always between Lowest and Highest.

Capacity.name: Capacity
Capacity.description: Maximum spectator capacity of the stadium; ranges from 2,000 to 52,500 (Hampden Park).

Highest.name: Highest attendance
Highest.description: Highest recorded attendance at the stadium; values 780-4,812.

Location.name: Location (home club)
Location.description: Despite the name, values are football club names (e.g. Ayr United, East Fife, Queen's Park), i.e. the club that plays at the stadium, not a city. Likely the home team of the stadium.

Lowest.name: Lowest attendance
Lowest.description: Lowest recorded attendance at the stadium; values 315-1,294.

Name.name: Stadium name
Name.description: Name of the stadium (e.g. Somerset Park, Hampden Park).

Stadium_ID.name: Stadium ID
Stadium_ID.description: Primary key; unique identifier of the stadium, referenced by concert.Stadium_ID.
